name: Dominik Cadmus
headline: Managing Director & Founder | Board Member | Marketing, Finance & Legal

positions.title: Co-Founder & Managing Director | CMO
positions.description:
As Co-Founder and Managing Director of Plantura, I was responsible for Performance Marketing, Finance, and Legal/Compliance – building these areas from scratch and scaling Plantura to double-digit million revenues.

In Performance Marketing, my focus was on efficiently scaling new customer acquisition and optimizing retention through targeted, customer-segmented initiatives. This included building and managing campaigns across channels and implementing a data-driven approach to maximize ROI.

On the Finance side, I built the team and structures for budgeting, controlling, and reporting, and successfully managed several financing rounds, including financial & legal due diligence. I also coordinated Legal and Data Protection matters, ensuring compliance as the company grew.

As part of the leadership team, I recruited, developed, and led up to six direct reports – from senior leaders to junior team members – fostering a results-driven but supportive culture.

Over 8 years, this work helped Plantura scale from an early-stage idea into one of Europe’s leading DTC gardening brands. Currently, I serve as a Board Member at Plantura, supporting the management team on strategic decisions and the company’s ongoing growth.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Managing Director
positions.description:
I co-founded a B2B SaaS platform for the ski industry, enabling ski resorts to sell lift passes online through a white-label e-commerce solution.

As Managing Director, I led go-to-market strategy, product-market-fit validation and B2B sales, acquiring ski resorts as early platform partners and building the commercial foundation of the business. The platform reached hundred thousand annual visits, providing strong validation for the digital distribution model. This experience gave me first-hand entrepreneurial exposure to building and scaling a venture from scratch in the B2B SaaS space.
